g.title: tech
g.text: How it works under the hood:
- World-stable icons: true heading at every camera angle
- Smooth motion: renders one interval behind real time,
interpolates between known fixes, dead reckoning fills gaps
- Sits on real ground: geoid-aware heights sampled against
- Live feeds arrive every 15-30s, globe interpolates between
- Share links: camera, style, layers, tracked target serialize into URL
(a live target is a handoff, not a bookmark)
